FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Reliable Plumbing & HVAC Solutions specializes in providing high-quality plumbing and HVAC services primarily for residential and light commercial properties. Our operations include installation, maintenance, and repair of heating, ventilation, air conditioning systems, water heaters, and plumbing fixtures. We are committed to ensuring safety and compliance with local, state, and federal building codes, and we do not engage in high-risk construction activities such as demolition or hazardous material abatement. Our team consists of licensed technicians who undergo regular training to stay updated on industry standards and safety practices. We maintain meticulous documentation of our safety protocols and equipment maintenance to ensure the highest level of service and minimize liability. Additionally, we only work with subcontractors who provide valid certificates of insurance, safeguarding our commitment to quality and risk management.

Our company specializes in plumbing and HVAC services, which sometimes requires us to handle demolition work to remove old systems and facilitate the installation of new units.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: "On 06/15/2022, we experienced a water leak due to a burst pipe caused by extreme temperature fluctuations, resulting in $5,000 in damages. The matter has been closed as repairs were completed promptly and we implemented preventive measures to avoid future occurrences."
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed.
